title: MIX Engine MCP Tool Definitions
description: Exposed Model Context Protocol tools for AI coding agents

tools.name: mix_do
tools.description: Execute a batch of AICommands; returns created/removed entities, warnings and errors.

commands.description: One command or an array (applied in order).

settleMs.description: How long to wait for async spawns/asset loads after the queue drains (default 200).

tools.name: mix_plan
tools.description: Preflight an AICommand batch without changing the engine: catches unknown commands, missing required parameters, unsafe payload keys, and atomic-rollback incompatibilities.

commands.description: One command or an ordered array to validate.

atomic.description: When true, also require every command to be safely reversible by a scene snapshot.

tools.name: mix_apply
tools.description: GUARDED APPLY: serialize competing IDE edits, preflight, execute, return a semantic diff, verify postconditions, auto-rollback failed scene edits, and deduplicate retries.

commands.description: One command or an ordered array. Entity fields accept numeric ids or stable @name, guid:<guid>, tag:<tag>, and selector-object refs resolved before mutation.

expects.description: Optional postconditions; a failure rolls back an atomic batch.

atomic.description: Require snapshot-safe commands and roll back failures (default true).

dryRun.description: Validate and return the plan without executing.

requestKey.description: Stable retry key (1..128 chars); identical retries return the original result without re-execution.

settleMs.description: How long to wait after async work settles (default 200).

tools.name: mix_resolve
tools.description: Resolve one stable semantic entity reference to its current numeric id and full entity info. Ambiguous names/tags fail with candidates instead of guessing.

ref.description: Stable selector to resolve against the current scene.

tools.name: mix_describe
tools.description: Token-efficient summary of the whole scene (entities, camera, bounds, selection, mode).

tools.name: mix_get
tools.description: Full info on one entity (kind, name, tags, world position + size, body type).

tools.name: mix_raycast
tools.description: Which entity is under a screen point — the agent's "look at the crosshair".

screen.description: Normalized [0,1] screen point; defaults to centre (0.5,0.5).

tools.name: mix_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a named in-memory snapshot of the scene.

tools.name: mix_restore
tools.description: Restore a previously-saved snapshot (entity ids are reissued).

tools.name: mix_checkpoints
tools.description: List the names of saved snapshots.

tools.name: mix_observe
tools.description: RENDER-grounded visual check (the agent's "look at the screen"): renders the live scene offscreen and reports frame health (black/blown-out) + per-entity on-screen PIXEL coverage + on-screen position + plain-English anomalies. Catches what state queries cannot — an entity can exist yet draw zero pixels (invisible, occluded, mis-scaled). Works headless.

filter.description: Optional; omit to observe all physics entities.

tools.name: mix_assert
tools.description: Evaluate expectations so the agent can validate its own edits — including RENDER-grounded visual ones.

expects.description: entity_exists | entity_count | entity_near | no_errors | entity_visible (name?/tag?/entityKind?/minCoveragePct?) | frame_renders.

tools.name: mix_status
tools.description: Engine liveness + a one-line scene summary.

tools.name: mix_find_path
tools.description: A* path between two world points (NavigationSystem). Returns waypoints + length.

tools.name: mix_nav_status
tools.description: Navmesh build state + every NavAgent (mode, speed, path, target).
